title: Order convergence in ordered vector spaces: compactness, atoms, pervasiveness, and ice cream spaces
summary: We study order convergence in ordered vector spaces that are not necessarily lattices. In this setting, we consider two generalizations of order convergence on vector lattices, a directed and an undirected variant. We show that these notions agree for the class of pervasive spaces and extend several results concerning atomicity and order convergence in vector lattices to this class. In particular, we prove that a pervasive JB-algebra is associative, which strengthens a result of Sherman for C*-algebras. We also establish a number of new characterizations of pervasive spaces.
